verdict.rationale: In Claude Code, install is two documented commands: `/plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace` then `/plugin install superpowers@superpowers-marketplace`. Skills then trigger automatically at session start with no further setup, which strongly implies a sub-five-minute path. The README also has a per-harness Getting Started section, and Devin and Antigravity get one-command installs. However, install steps differ by harness, and Codex/OpenCode rely on telling the agent to fetch and follow a raw INSTALL.md. missing for 10: an explicit timed quickstart or verification step confirming the skill works, independent hands-on reports of setup time, and a uniform install path across harnesses.
